name: Overall Churn Rate
defn: Share of members whose latest billing cycle ended more than 30 days before the pipeline as-of date (2026-08-14).
note: Read with kpi_15. The pipeline date sits 313 days past the last real event, so this figure is inflated by missing data, not only by behaviour.

name: Overall Retention Rate
note: The mirror of kpi_01, so it carries the same as-of caveat.

name: Active Members
defn: Members not classified as churned as of the pipeline as-of date.
note: This is the population the composite risk score runs on: Low 487, Moderate 403, Elevated 109, High 12.

name: 7-Day Activation Rate
defn: Share of members who log any gym or app event within 7 days of their join date.
note: The largest single drop in the funnel: 81.2% of members never engage in week one.

name: Renewal Follow-Through Rate
defn: Of members who ever subscribed, the share who renewed at least once more.
note: Healthy next to activation. Renewal is not where the platform leaks.

name: Median Revenue per Member
defn: Median total rupees paid per member. Median is preferred because spend is heavily right-skewed.
note: Quote this one when you need a typical member.

name: Mean Revenue per Member
defn: Mean total rupees paid per member, reported next to the median to show the skew.
note: Roughly double the median: a few large payers pull the mean up.

name: Discount Utilisation Rate
defn: Share of distinct renewal records with a discount applied.

name: Corporate Tie-Up Mix
defn: Share of distinct renewal records under a corporate tie-up plan.

name: Median Plan-to-Engagement Ratio
defn: Median rupees paid per logged gym session. Surfaces members who are paying but not showing up.
note: The twelve flagged members sit at 48,000 to 102,000 on this measure.

name: Avg Weekly Session Rate
defn: Mean of each member's rolling 4-week sessions per week.

name: Avg Session Consistency Score
defn: Mean coefficient of variation of the gaps between sessions. Lower means more regular attendance.
note: The name is misleading: a lower score is better.

name: Avg Streak Length
defn: Mean of each member's average streak length.

name: Streak-Break Recovery Rate
defn: Share of finished streaks followed by a gym check-in within 14 days (streak grain).
note: Over all finished streaks in the raw table the figure is 10.3%. The two differ because of the denominator.

name: Churn Rate (data-realistic as-of)
defn: The same churn logic anchored at the last real event in the data, 2025-10-05.
note: Treat this as the operationally meaningful number and always show it beside kpi_01.
